newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down on initial high offers.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down on initial high offers.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia ended 10 cents lower at 14.17 ringgit ($5.69) a kg as overseas demand was lacking, traders said.
"The market was down mainly because of poor buying from overseas," a trader said, adding that an initial higher offering also weakened sentiment.
Traders said there was an offer of 96 tonnes against bid of 46. Turnover was 86 tonnes compared with 127 on Thursday, with buying from Europe and Malaysia.
The local price premium fell to $55 a tonne from $90.
